causes.label: demand
causes.quote: One of the main contributors to the high prices was high demand due to extreme heat.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: A plant outage at Northern Power Station, lower than forecast contribution from wind and interconnector import flows also contributed to tight supply conditions.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: At 4 pm wind generation was around 85 MW, half that forecast four hours ahead. The reduced output from wind generation exacerbated the supply situation and contributed to the high prices at 4 pm and 4.30 pm.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Both the Heywood and Murraylink interconnectors were constrained at their import limits for much of the afternoon.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Rebidding by participants was also an important factor. Rebidding during the afternoon, particularly by AGL and GDF Suez, shifted significant capacity that was priced under $300/MWh to prices at or near the price cap.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: The import limit across Murraylink was close to forecast but limited to around 5 MW due to the outage of the Murraylink runback scheme

interconnectors_named.name: Heywood
interconnectors_named.quote: Both the Heywood and Murraylink interconnectors were constrained at their import limits for much of the afternoon.

interconnectors_named.name: Murraylink
interconnectors_named.quote: Both the Heywood and Murraylink interconnectors were constrained at their import limits for much of the afternoon.

intervals.quote: On Thursday 19 December 2013 the spot price in South Australia reached $10 627/MWh at 4 pm and $5640/MWh at 4.30 pm. These were the highest spot prices in the high-price period from 2.30 pm to 6 pm inclusive, during which time the (five-minute) dispatch price exceeded $10 000/MWh on 17 occasions.

network_outages.quote: The import limit across Murraylink was close to forecast but limited to around 5 MW due to the outage of the Murraylink runback scheme

peak_price.quote: On Thursday 19 December 2013 the spot price in South Australia reached $10 627/MWh at 4 pm and $5640/MWh at 4.30 pm.
